vot_first_blood.description: Kill Mottled Boars on Sagebrush Flat, west of camp.
vot_first_blood.accept_text:
Easy, take it slow. You took a fall. I'm Nakhtar, and you're not the first one to wake up here like this, so don't worry about it.

Can you still swing a weapon? Go and kill a few of the boars out on Sagebrush Flat, just west of camp, and we'll find out.
vot_first_blood.turn_in_text: Good, you can still fight. Get some food in you before you head back out. Thanks.

vot_scorpid_trouble.description: Kill Scorpid Workers at the nest north-east of camp.
vot_scorpid_trouble.accept_text:
The scorpids have been wandering a lot further from their nest the last few days. Could you go and kill some of the workers? The nest's north-east of camp.

Watch the tail, that's where the sting is.
vot_scorpid_trouble.turn_in_text: That'll push them back for a bit. Thanks. Have a look through the camp stores and take something you can use.

vot_den_scout.description: Go into the Den, the cave west of camp, have a look around and come back to Kuraw.
vot_den_scout.accept_text:
I'm Kuraw. Have you been in a cave yet? The Den's a small one in the ridge west of camp, and it's a good one to start with.

Go in and have a look around. Be careful in the small rooms, you can end up with three of them on you at once. Come back and tell me what's in there.
vot_den_scout.turn_in_text: Alright, that's useful, thanks. Now I know what we're dealing with in there.

vot_nest_guardian.description: Kill the Nest Guardian in the deepest room of the Den, west of camp.
vot_nest_guardian.accept_text:
There's a big one at the back of the Den the recruits call the Nest Guardian, and it's started wandering the halls. It's the first thing round here that can actually kill you, so take it seriously.

It's in the last room, past the nursery. Can you go and deal with it?
vot_nest_guardian.turn_in_text: You got it? Nice work. Thanks for that.

vot_vile_familiars.description: Kill Vile Familiars in the Burning Blade Coven, north-east of camp past the scorpid nest.
vot_vile_familiars.accept_text:
We've got demons in the valley now, if you can believe it. I've been on watch here three years and never saw one until last week.

They're in the Burning Blade Coven, the cave at the end of the road north-east of camp, past the scorpids. Can you go in and kill some of the familiars? Don't go any deeper than that on your own, though.
vot_vile_familiars.turn_in_text: Thanks. It's gone quiet in there for now, but whoever's in charge of them is still around.

vot_yarrog_baneshadow.description: Kill Yarrog Baneshadow at the back of the Burning Blade Coven, north-east of camp.
vot_yarrog_baneshadow.accept_text:
We found out who's running that cave. His name's Yarrog Baneshadow, and he's right at the back of the Coven.

He keeps calling more demons in the longer you fight him, so go straight for him and don't drag it out. I'd go myself but I can't leave the road.
vot_yarrog_baneshadow.turn_in_text: He's dead? Great. That's a big help, thank you.

vot_sagewood_petals.description: Bring Marta Sagewood Petals from the sprites in the sagewood grove, just east of camp.
vot_sagewood_petals.accept_text:
Half the recruits come back from the nest with scorpid venom in them, and I'm out of sagewood petals for the remedy.

The sprites in the grove just east of camp drop them if you spook them. Could you get me some? Try not to squash them.
vot_sagewood_petals.turn_in_text: These are perfect, thanks. That'll keep a few of them on their feet.

vot_felstalkers.description: Kill Felstalker Whelps in the Burning Blade Coven, north-east of camp.
vot_felstalkers.accept_text:
The demons brought hounds with them too. You'll probably run into them in the Coven before anything else.

While you're in there, can you kill some of the whelps? No point making two trips.
vot_felstalkers.turn_in_text: Thanks. That's a lot less of them to worry about.

vot_graduation.description: Follow the road east out of the valley to Razor Hill and find Weapons Trainer Grokk.
vot_graduation.accept_text:
I think you're done here, honestly. You've handled everything this valley's got.

Head into Durotar and go to Razor Hill. Just follow the road east out of the valley and stay on it. When you get there, find Grokk, the weapons trainer, and tell him I sent you.
vot_graduation.turn_in_text: Nakhtar sent you? Good, welcome to Razor Hill. Come and find me whenever you want some training.

vot_old_tusk.description: Kill Mottled Boars and Old Tusk on Sagebrush Flat, west of camp.
vot_old_tusk.accept_text:
There's one boar out on Sagebrush Flat that's way bigger than the rest. The recruits call him Old Tusk. He keeps charging through the training dummies, and he's going to hurt somebody soon.

Can you go and kill him? Take out a few of the other boars first and he'll come to you. He's the one that doesn't run.
vot_old_tusk.turn_in_text: You got Old Tusk? Brilliant, I've been worried about that one for ages. Here, take these.

vot_carrion_circle.description: Kill Carrion Vultures and Dustwind Jackals in the Windrift Dunes, east of camp.
vot_carrion_circle.accept_text:
Don't tell Nakhtar I'm handing out jobs, he wants me resting. A scorpid got my leg and I can't walk on it yet.

The vultures have started circling over me every afternoon, and the jackals keep creeping closer at night. It's getting on my nerves. They hang around the Windrift Dunes, east of camp. Could you go and thin them out?
vot_carrion_circle.turn_in_text: Ah, that's so much better. Thanks. I'm not supposed to give out coin, but here, have some of my old gear.

vot_troubled_waters.description: Kill Marsh Skimmers and Trailwater Toads at Trailwater Spring, south of camp.
vot_troubled_waters.accept_text:
I can't get clean water out of the spring south of camp any more. It's crawling with skimmers, and the toads keep stirring up the mud.

Could you kill some of the skimmers and toads for me? Watch your step at the edge, the mud's deep.
vot_troubled_waters.turn_in_text: It's clearing up already. Thanks so much.

vot_gulpjaw.description: Kill Old Gulpjaw and Trailwater Toads at Trailwater Spring, south of camp.
vot_gulpjaw.accept_text:
So it wasn't just the skimmers. There's a huge toad living in the spring now, the recruits call it Old Gulpjaw, and it's started going for people.

It sits at the bottom and waits. If you kill a couple of the smaller toads it'll come up. Fight it on the bank, don't go in the water after it.
vot_gulpjaw.turn_in_text: It's gone? Oh, thank goodness. Thank you.

vot_heartwood.description: Kill Thornroot Saplings and Bramblethorn the Ancient in the sagewood grove, just east of camp.
vot_heartwood.accept_text:
Something's wrong in the sagewood grove. The saplings have started walking around and attacking people, and there's a big old tree moving with them. Everyone calls it Bramblethorn.

Could you kill some of the saplings and then deal with Bramblethorn? The grove's just east of camp.
vot_heartwood.turn_in_text: It's so much quieter in there now. Thank you, take whatever you like.

vot_brood_below.description: Kill Cave Skitterers, Den Webspinners and Egg Tenders in the Den, west of camp.
vot_brood_below.accept_text:
The Den's basically a nest, and there's a lot more of them further in. I want them thinned out before anyone goes after the big one at the back.

Can you clear out some of the skitterers and webspinners, and the egg tenders in the nursery?
vot_brood_below.turn_in_text: Thanks, that'll make the next bit a lot easier.

vot_windrift_omens.description: Kill Dust Devils and Sandpincer Crawlers in the Windrift Dunes, east of camp.
vot_windrift_omens.accept_text:
Something weird is going on out in the Windrift Dunes. The dust devils keep following the road, and sandpincers are popping up out of nowhere.

Can you go out there and kill some of the dust devils and sandpincers? If the sand starts moving under you, get off it quick.
vot_windrift_omens.turn_in_text: Thanks. It's much calmer out there now. Come and see me when you're ready, there's one more thing.

vot_cinderjaw.description: Kill Ember Wisps, Ashback Basilisks and Smolderhide in the Cinderjaw Wastes, far south-west past the lake.
vot_cinderjaw.accept_text:
Way down in the south-west, past the lake, there's a patch of burnt ground called the Cinderjaw Wastes. It's been spreading toward the lake for years.

There are fire wisps and basilisks out there, and a big thing the scouts call Smolderhide. Can you clear out some of the wisps and basilisks, and then kill Smolderhide? It's the toughest job I've got, so don't feel bad if you want to wait.
vot_cinderjaw.turn_in_text: You actually killed Smolderhide? That's amazing. Thank you.

vot_grosks_trophy.description: Kill Dustwind Jackals and Sandfang in the Windrift Dunes, east of camp, for Grosk.
vot_grosks_trophy.accept_text:
Hey, you're the one everyone's talking about, right? I need a favour.

There's this old white jackal out in the Windrift Dunes called Sandfang. Nobody's ever caught it. I want it as a trophy before I leave the valley, but I can't catch it on my own.

Can you kill some of its pack and then get Sandfang? Please don't tell my mum.
vot_grosks_trophy.turn_in_text: No way, you got it! Thanks so much. My mum's going to kill me. Here, take this.

vot_fel_shards.description: Bring Fizzcrank Fel-Tainted Shards from the acolytes, initiates and ritual guards in the Burning Blade Coven, north-east of camp.
vot_fel_shards.accept_text:
Oh, hello! Are you going into the Coven? The crystals in there give off this weird heat and I'd love to know why.

The cultists carry little shards of it on their belts. Could you bring me some? Don't grab them with your bare hands, though.
vot_fel_shards.turn_in_text: Oh, these are great, thank you! Hang on, is that one smoking? Never mind, take anything you want off the bench.

vot_silk_for_rhaka.description: Bring Rhaka Den Silk Spools from the webspinners and skitterers in the Den, west of camp.
vot_silk_for_rhaka.accept_text:
My son's one of the recruits, and I want to make him a proper cloak before he goes out again. The silk the webspinners make in the Den is really strong.

I can't make myself go in there, though. Could you get me some spools? The Den's the cave in the ridge west of camp.
vot_silk_for_rhaka.turn_in_text: This is lovely silk, thank you. I made an extra one while I waited, it's yours.

vot_mother_of_nest.description: Kill Venomtail Scorpids and Broodmother Sarrix at the scorpid nest, north-east of camp.
vot_mother_of_nest.accept_text:
All those scorpids come from one big mother at the nest, Broodmother Sarrix. As long as she's alive they'll just keep coming.

She's got venomtails guarding her, so kill a few of those first and then go for her. It's a long fight, so make sure you're healed up before you start.
vot_mother_of_nest.turn_in_text: Sarrix is dead? That's huge. Thanks.

vot_ritual_disruption.description: Kill Burning Blade Initiates and Coven Ritual Guards in the Burning Blade Coven, north-east of camp.
vot_ritual_disruption.accept_text:
Bad news. They're drawing a summoning circle deeper in the Coven, and if they finish it we're going to have something a lot worse than Baneshadow on our hands.

Can you kill some of the initiates and the ritual guards? Get the guards first if you can, they're the ones doing the summoning.
vot_ritual_disruption.turn_in_text: The circle's broken? Thank you. Now it's just Baneshadow left in there.
